sanskrit_verse:
सप्राड्विवाकः सामात्यः सब्राह्मणपुरोहितः ।
ससभ्यः प्रेक्षको राजा स्वर्गे तिष्ठति धर्मतः ॥७०॥
transliteration: saprāḍvivākaḥ sāmātyaḥ sabrāhmaṇapurohitaḥ | sa sabhyaḥ prekṣako rājā svarge tiṣṭhati dharmataḥ ||70||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King who governs with open consultation, surrounded by ministers, Brahmanas, priests, assembly members, and observers, stands lawfully in svarga.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is realized through transparent inclusion of all relevant stakeholders.
Causation arises from visibility and collective witnessing of governance actions.
Capacity-based responsibility requires active engagement with advisors and subjects.
Restoration logic demands that leadership remain accessible and accountable to dharma.
Consciousness alignment occurs when rulers act within a field of shared awareness and integrity.
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler makes decision THEN it MUST be preceded by documented consultation with designated advisors.
IF decision affects public THEN representative assembly MUST witness or acknowledge decision-making process.
IF priestly guidance is required THEN Brahmana advisors MUST affirm alignment with Vedic principles.
IF any stakeholder raises objection THEN review protocol MUST activate before implementation proceeds.
IF king isolates himself from counsel THEN automated advisory system MUST initiate reconnection sequence.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that highest executive authority remains valid only when exercised under full transparency and witnessed legitimacy. Isolated decisions without counsel breach constitutional dharma and nullify sovereign standing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that right action manifests through inclusive causality. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that isolation leads to misalignment; thus sequential participation ensures correctness. Proportional responsibility lies not in individual fault but in maintaining systemic visibility. Non-punitive reality holds that correction arises naturally when transparency is restored.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate mandatory council reassembly protocol upon detection of unilateral decree issuance.
Deploy witness integration mechanism ensuring representation from all societal pillars.
Activate spiritual advisor confirmation loop to realign policy with cosmic order.
Establish continuous feedback assimilation cycle between ruler and governed.
Reinstate ceremonial exposure rituals to restore public trust and divine sanction.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: Dharma prevails where rulers walk openly among witnesses. Svarga awaits those whose reign reflects universal observation. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. There is no punishment—only return to alignment.
